verdict.rationale: The evidence points to a public first-party source repository at github.com/keycloak/keycloak, and community users describe Keycloak as a FOSS project. Together these indicate the source is readable under an open license, though no license is named. missing for 10: explicit first-party statement of the specific open-source license (e.g., a LICENSE file or docs reference), direct evidence of the core server source contents rather than an adapter-described repo entry.
